author: Serhat
title: Android tablet 2560x1600 Windows extended display over USB
content_text:
Turned an Android tablet into a native 2560x1600 Windows extended monitor over USB.

Decoder limits blocked full frames, so it runs two 2560x800 NVENC streams concurrently.

Sustained 45.3 fps with 48 ms median latency at 20.0 Mbit/s.

media_assets.caption: Lenovo TB336FU Android tablet running native 2560x1600 Windows extended display alongside laptop over USB cable.
